notes: Spine (18): need for binder-free printable micro-devices -> multitasking-ink hypothesis -> aqueous Ti3C2Tx base -> H/L concentration sweep -> etching+delamination -> printable rheology (PRP) -> down-select the H ink -> screen printing -> shear-alignment/recovery MEC -> aligned continuous lamellar film (STR) -> areal capacitance with layer number (PRP) -> MX-MSC cycling stability (PRF); second branch from the same hypothesis: LTO/LFP hybrid inks (DES/modification) -> stepwise printing -> particles embedded in the MXene skeleton (STR/interface) -> areal capacity (PRP) -> integrated self-powered system (PRF) -> conclusion. The screen-then-choose pattern PRC -> PRP(ink) -> DES/down_select -> PRC is allowed by the v04 down_select rule. Two causes edges enter n11 and both carry mode=joint; no other claim has more than one causes edge. Judge splits: n12 (cycling vs bending), c2 (electrode network vs interconnect sufficiency), c5/o21 (bending vs cycling retention), o15 (capacitance bar vs Ragone). Audits (3): o23 text_silent (self-discharge starts at ~2.05 V, not the 2.3 V of the text), a1 (DSC/limitation) qualifying n17, and o7 contrasting o6. Packet defects found: (i) F3 and F5, the two largest multi-panel figures (11 and 8 panels), are tier C with no panels offered, so every F3/F5 node cites figs only with panel_ids [] and attrs.fig_ref; (ii) OCR panel letters are wrong for F2b ('d'), F2d ('p') and F4d ('p') although the crops match their caption spans; (iii) the F2 caption is truncated at 'h) ...' and its tail is split across the F2h ('Top-view and') and F2i caption spans; (iv) the linked text cites 'Figure 4d' for the GCD profiles, which are F4i (F4d is the schematic); (v) the F2e caption OCR reads '0.1s^-7' and '700s^-1' where the linked text says 0.1 and 100 s-1. Figure-vs-text conflicts recorded in image_note: F2f (G' and G'' overlap for the H ink), F4l (Li//LiCoO2 sits above this work's Ragone curve at matched power), F5c (2.05 V start), F4h ('entirely embedded' overstated), F4k (dips to ~65% near cycle 800). Not in the graph: SI-only results (zeta potential, sheet resistances of the battery electrodes, MSCs on glass/wood/fabric/rubber, series/parallel MSC packs, 100 tandem cells at 60 V in F3k, the MXene hydrogel recipe, the 1.2 nm interlayer spacing as a cause of capacitance) and F2g (panel offered but not cited; the printed logos are covered by o6).

checklist.spine_primary_argument: yes: need -> multitasking-ink hypothesis -> aqueous Ti3C2Tx base -> H/L concentration sweep -> etch+delaminate -> printable rheology (PRP) -> down-select H ink -> screen printing -> shear-alignment MEC -> aligned lamellar film (STR) -> areal capacitance vs printed layers (PRP) -> 10 000-cycle stability (PRF) -> conclusion; parallel branch: hybrid LTO/LFP inks (DES) -> stepwise printing -> embedded particles in the MXene skeleton (STR/interface) -> areal capacity (PRP) -> self-powered integrated system (PRF) -> conclusion
checklist.spine_claims_evidenced: n6 (o2,o3,o4,o5; c1 premise), n9 (basis=argued; o4, c1 premises), n10 (o8,o9), n11 (o10; k1 premise), n12 (o13), n15 (o18,o19), n16 (o20), n17 (o24,o25,o26)
checklist.v04_rules: pass. The screen-then-choose shape PRC(n5) -causes-> PRP(n6, object=ink) -motivates-> DES/down_select(n7) -realizes-> PRC(n8) is the v04 down_select rule ('down_select has an incoming motivates edge from a RESULT of this paper; screen-then-choose papers put it on the spine'), not the tool/assembly exception, so attrs.object stays 'ink'. c2 stays PRP/descriptor (it explains n11, it is not the headline property); the new c8 is PRP/value, not PRF/qualification, because the benchmark it is weighed against (carbon-coated Al foil) sits in the SI text.
checklist.audits: 3 (o23 text_silent; a1 DSC/limitation qualifying n17; o7 contrasting o6). Within the budget of 5 and fair: each changes the support of a spine claim.

changes: n12 split: 10 000-cycle capacitance retention (n12, spine, evidence o13) and the unchanged CV curves under bending (new n19, side, evidence o14 moved). n10 causes n19; n19 supports n18. n19 is kept off the spine so the MSC branch keeps one PRF leaf and the graph keeps two parallel branches.

c2 split: the conductive network whose resistance falls with printed layers (c2, evidence o11, still a joint cause of n11) and the sufficiency of printed MXene lines as metal-free collectors and interconnects (new c8, PRP/value, evidence o12 moved). c2 supports c8; c8 supports n18, which gives the 'interconnect' half of hypothesis n2 a carrier it previously lacked.
c5 split: full capacity through 1000 bends (c5, evidence o21) and ~80% retention after 1000 charge-discharge cycles (new c7, evidence o27). Both support n17.
o21 split: F4j bending retention (o21) and F4k cycling retention (new o27). o21 now cites only #F4j and o27 only #F4k; the set of cited panels is unchanged.
o15 split: the F3e areal-capacitance bar ranking (o15, evidences c6) and the F3g Ragone curve (new o28, evidences c6 and is premise_for c4, the edge moved from o15).
